## Overview

|             |                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| **Input**   | `autism_ipp_imputed.rds`                        |
| **Output**  |                                                 |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Dependencies"}
The parent folder of this document's folder should contain a folder called `Data` with the file `autism_ipp_imputed.rds`. The script `autism_ipp_imputation.qmd` will produce this file if it is not yet present. The parent folder should also contain a folder called `Output`.
:::

## Set up

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Working directory"}
Quarto runs code from the folder this `.qmd` file is saved in, so you don't need `setwd()`. Relative paths like `../Data/` work as long as the folder layout above is in place.
:::

### Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(mice)
# install.packages(c("flextable", "officer", "gtsummary", "psych")) # use once then comment out
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(gtsummary)
library(psych)

```

### Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

recoded_data <- readRDS("../Data/autism_ipp_recoded.rds")
imputed_data <- readRDS("../Data/autism_ipp_imputed.rds")
completed_sets <- complete(imputed_data, action = "all") # extract the 20 imputed datasets

```

## Drop rows
Drop rows (people) that are missing data on the dependent variables to create two data sets. 

### Interprofessional collaboration
First, drop people who are missing data on either frequency of collaboration or number of collaborators for interprofessional collaboration. 
```{r}
#| label: drop rows interprofessional collab

interpro_recoded_data <- recoded_data |>
                            drop_na(interpro_num, interpro_freq)

interpro_imputed_data <- lapply(completed_sets, function(data) { # drop NA in each of 20 imputed datasets
  drop_na(data, interpro_num, interpro_freq)
})
```

### Interagency collaboration
Second, drop people who are missing data on either frequency of collaboration or number of collaborators for interagency collaboration.
```{r}
#| label: drop rows interagency collab

interag_recoded_data <- recoded_data |>
                            drop_na(interag_num, interag_freq)

interag_imputed_data <- lapply(completed_sets, function(data) { # drop NA in each of 20 imputed datasets
  drop_na(data, interag_num, interag_freq)
})
```

## Descriptive tables

### Table 2
```{r}
#| label: create table 2

# Check all that apply variables
race_vars <- c("race_dem___80", "race_dem___40", "race_dem___30", "race_dem___10",
               "race_dem___20", "race_dem___60", "race_dem___50", "race_dem___70",
               "race_dem___100")
internship_vars <- c("intern_school", "intern_consortium", "intern_residential",
                     "intern_community_mh", "intern_other", "intern_hospital",
                     "intern_health_sci", "intern_detention")
checkbox_vars <- c(race_vars, internship_vars)

# Specify options, labels, and create table
table_data <- recoded_data |>
  droplevels() |>   # remove unused factor variable levels (0 people)
  mutate(district = replace_na(as.character(district), "Missing")) |> # "Missing" category for district
  select(gender, all_of(race_vars), degree, # pick variables to include
         masters_nasp, specialist_nasp, doctorate_nasp, doctorate_apa,
         all_of(internship_vars),
         practice_setting, district)
table2 <- tbl_summary(data = table_data,
                      type = list(all_of(checkbox_vars) ~ "dichotomous"), # show just counts for == 1
                      value = list(all_of(checkbox_vars) ~ 1),
                      statistic = all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)", # count and percents
                      digits = all_categorical() ~ c(0,1), # 0 decimals for counts, 1 decimal for percents
                      missing = "no", # suppresses structural NAs (like in accreditation vars)
                      label = list(gender = "Gender",
                                   race_dem___80 = "Race/ethnicity: White",
                                   race_dem___40 = "Race/ethnicity: Latino/a/x/e",
                                   race_dem___30 = "Race/ethnicity: Black or African American",
                                   race_dem___10 = "Race/ethnicity: Asian or Asian American",
                                   race_dem___20 = "Race/ethnicity: Biracial or Multiracial",
                                   race_dem___60 = "Race/ethnicity: Native American, Alaska Native, or Indigenous",
                                   race_dem___50 = "Race/ethnicity: Middle Eastern or North African",
                                   race_dem___70 = "Race/ethnicity: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
                                   race_dem___100 = "Race/ethnicity: Prefer not to respond",
                                   race_dem___90 = "Race/ethnicity: Other",
                                   degree = "Highest degree earned",
                                   masters_nasp = "Master's degree: NASP accredited",
                                   specialist_nasp = "Specialist degree: NASP accredited",
                                   doctorate_nasp = "Doctorate: NASP accredited",
                                   doctorate_apa = "Doctorate: APA accredited",
                                   intern_school = "Internship: Schools",
                                   intern_consortium = "Internship: Consortium",
                                   intern_residential = "Internship: Residential Treatment Center",
                                   intern_community_mh = "Internship: Community Mental Health Center",
                                   intern_other = "Internship: Other",
                                   intern_hospital = "Internship: Children's Hospital",
                                   intern_health_sci = "Internship: Health Science Center",
                                   intern_detention = "Internship: Juvenile Detention Center",
                                   practice_setting = "Practice setting",
                                   district = "School district type"))

# Convert the table to Word format and export it
table2_word <- as_flex_table(table2)
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par(paste0("Table 2. Participant Characteristics (N = ", nrow(recoded_data), ")"), # title
               style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_flextable(value = table2_word) |> # table
  body_add_par("Note. Race/ethnicity and internship setting were check-all-that-apply items, so percentages may sum to more than 100%.", style = "Normal") # footnote
print(doc, target = "../Output/table2_participant_characteristics.docx") # save file
```

### Table 4
```{r}
#| label: create table 4

# Keep & label study variables
table4_data <- recoded_data |>
  select(perceived_know, fact_know_asksp, train_quality,
         att_effic_atihct, att_quality_atihct,
         interpro_num, interpro_freq, interag_num, interag_freq)
variable_labels <- c(perceived_know = "Self-rated autism knowledge",
                     fact_know_asksp = "Factual autism knowledge",
                     train_quality = "Autism training",
                     att_effic_atihct = "Attitudes toward IPP: Efficacy",
                     att_quality_atihct = "Attitudes toward IPP: Quality",
                     interpro_num = "Total interprofessional collaboration",
                     interpro_freq = "Frequency of interprofessional collaboration",
                     interag_num = "Total interagency collaboration",
                     interag_freq = "Frequency of interagency collaboration")

# Get descriptive statistics and sample size
descriptives <- describe(table4_data, na.rm = TRUE, type = 1) |>
  rownames_to_column("variable")
N <- nrow(recoded_data)
table4 <- descriptives |>
  mutate(Variable = unname(variable_labels[variable]),
         Range = paste(sprintf("%.0f", min), sprintf("%.0f", max), sep = "–"), 
         `n Missing` = N - n) |>
  select(Variable, M = mean, SD = sd, Range, Skewness = skew, Kurtosis = kurtosis, `n Missing`) |>
  mutate(across(c(M, SD, Skewness, Kurtosis), ~ round(.x, 2)), `n Missing` = round(`n Missing`, 0)) # round

# Create table and export
ft <- flextable(table4) |>
  colformat_num(j = c("M", "SD", "Skewness", "Kurtosis"), digits = 2) |> # format columns
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit()
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par(paste0("Table 4. Descriptive Statistics for Study Variables (N = ", N, ")"),
                style = "heading 1" ) |> # title
  body_add_flextable(value = ft) |> # table
  body_add_par("Note: Autism Spectrum Knowledge Scale for Professional Populations–Revised (ASKSP-R); Attitudes Toward Interdisciplinary Health Care Teams Scale (ATIHCTS); Interprofessional practice (IPP)", 
               style = "Normal")
print(doc, target = "../Output/table4_descriptive_statistics.docx") # save to file
```

### Table 5
```{r}
#| label: create table 5

# Match each collaborator variable to its frequency variable.
interpro_items <- tibble(
  Professional = c("Speech Language Pathologists/Therapists", "Special Education Teachers",
                   "General Education Teachers", "Occupational Therapists",
                   "Social Workers", "Behavior Specialists",
                   "School Nurses", "Physical Therapists", "School Counselors", 
                   "Academic Specialists", "Other", "Audiologists"),
  checkbox = paste0("collab_prim___", c(20, 100, 110, 30, 70, 80, 50, 40, 60, 90, 120, 10)),
  frequency = c("collab_prim_slp", "collab_prim_sped", "collab_prim_ge",
                "collab_prim_ot", "collab_prim_sw", "collab_prim_bs",
                "collab_prim_sn", "collab_prim_pt", "collab_prim_sc",
                "collab_prim_as", NA, "collab_prim_aud"))
interag_items <- tibble(
  Professional = c("Mental/Behavioral Health Providers", "Behavior Analysts",
                   "Speech Language Pathologists/Therapists", "Psychiatrists",
                   "Occupational Therapists", "Primary Care Providers",
                   "Social Workers", "Other", "Physical Therapists", "Audiologists"),
  checkbox = paste0("interout_prim___", c(70, 90, 20, 60, 30, 50, 80, 100, 40, 10)),
  frequency = c("interout_prim_ment", "interout_prim_ba", "interout_prim_slp", 
                "interout_prim_psych", "interout_prim_ot", "interout_prim_pcp",
                "interout_prim_sw", NA, "interout_prim_pt", "interout_prim_aud"))

# Calculate counts, percentages, and frequency stats using a helper function
make_collaborator_rows <- function(data, items, eligible_variable) {

  # Count people included in this table section
  N <- sum(!is.na(data[[eligible_variable]]))

  # "Other" has no frequency variable, so remove to add back later
  frequency_items <- items |>
    filter(Professional != "Other")

  # Calculate results for each professional with a frequency rating.
  results <- vector("list", nrow(frequency_items)) # set up vector to fill in
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(frequency_items))) { # for each collaborator other than "other"
    checkbox_column <- frequency_items$checkbox[i] 
    frequency_column <- frequency_items$frequency[i]
    
    # Number of participants selecting
    selected <- data[[checkbox_column]] == 1
    selected[is.na(selected)] <- FALSE # make NA mean no
    n_selected <- sum(selected)
    
    # Get frequency values for people who selected this collaborator
    selected_frequencies <- data[[frequency_column]][selected]
    n_missing <- sum(is.na(selected_frequencies))
    observed_frequencies <- selected_frequencies[!is.na(selected_frequencies)]
    
    # Frequency descriptive statistics
    results[[i]] <- tibble(Professional = frequency_items$Professional[i],
                           n = as.character(n_selected),
                           `%` = as.character(round(100 * n_selected / N)),
                           Mean = sprintf("%.2f", mean(observed_frequencies)),
                           SD = sprintf("%.2f", sd(observed_frequencies)),
                           Median = sprintf("%.2f", median(observed_frequencies)),
                           `Range (0–100)` = sprintf("%.0f–%.0f", min(observed_frequencies),
                                                     max(observed_frequencies)),
                           `n Missing` = as.character(n_missing))
  }

  # Add the "Other" row with counts only.
  other_item <- items |>
    filter(Professional == "Other")
  selected_other <- data[[other_item$checkbox]] == 1
  selected_other[is.na(selected_other)] <- FALSE
  n_other <- sum(selected_other)
  other_row <- tibble(Professional = "Other", 
                      n = as.character(n_other),
                      `%` = as.character(round(100 * n_other / N)),
                      Mean = "-", SD = "-", Median = "-", `Range (0–100)` = "-", 
                      `n Missing` = "-")

  # Combine the rows in the order specified
  bind_rows(results, other_row) |>
    arrange(match(Professional, items$Professional))
}

# Add the two section headings and their rows using helper function
interpro_N <- sum(!is.na(recoded_data$multidis_prim)) # number of observations for section
interag_N <- sum(!is.na(recoded_data$interagency_prim))
interpro_rows <- make_collaborator_rows(recoded_data, interpro_items, "multidis_prim")
interag_rows <- make_collaborator_rows(recoded_data, interag_items, "interagency_prim")
section_row <- function(title) { # helper function for section row (e.g., Interagency Collaboration)
  tibble(
    Professional = title,
    n = "",
    `%` = "",
    Mean = "",
    SD = "",
    Median = "",
    `Range (0–100)` = "",
    `n Missing` = ""
  )
}
table5 <- bind_rows(section_row(paste0("Interprofessional Collaboration (N = ", interpro_N, ")")),
                    interpro_rows,
                    section_row(paste0("Interagency Collaboration (N = ", interag_N, ")")),
                    interag_rows)

# Format and export to word
section_rows <- which(grepl("Collaboration \\(N =", table5$Professional))
ft <- flextable(table5) |>
  bold(i = section_rows, bold = TRUE, j = "Professional") |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit()
doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("Table 5. School Psychologists' Report of IPP during Autism Eligibility Determination",
               style = "heading 1") |> # title
  body_add_flextable(value = ft) |> # table
  body_add_par("Note. “Other” represents disciplines not specifically listed in the table.",
               style = "Normal") # footnote
print(doc, target = "../Output/table5_collaboration_by_professional.docx") # save to file

```
